hooks.name: Block API keys from being written into files
hooks.description: Stops the agent from writing a Gemini API key into any file. Added after the key was pasted into app/.env during development; the app folder is the wrong place for it, and one EXPO_PUBLIC_ prefix away from being bundled into the app.

action.command: if grep -qE 'AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{30,}'; then echo 'Blocked: this edit contains a Google API key. Keys belong only in server/.env or Vercel environment variables, never in app/, web/src/, or EXPO_PUBLIC_ variables.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
